rules.text: Items purchased in-store may be returned within 30 days of purchase.
rules.quote: You may return Merchandise purchased in-store to any open HomeGoods store within 30 days of purchase.

rules.text: Returns with a receipt must be made within 30 days of purchase for an exchange or refund.
rules.quote: If you're not satisfied with your purchase, please return merchandise accompanied by a register receipt within 30 days of purchase, for an exchange or refund.

rules.text: Returns with receipts over 30 days or without a receipt will receive store credit only.
rules.quote: Returns with receipts over 30 days or without a receipt (but otherwise eligible for return) will receive store credit only.

rules.text: A valid government-issued photo ID, name, address, and signature are required for returns without a valid receipt or gift receipt.
rules.quote: Any valid government issued photo ID, name, address, and signature are required for returns without a valid receipt or gift receipt.

rules.text: Returns without a receipt will receive a non-transferable merchandise credit.
rules.quote: Returns without a receipt will receive a non-transferable merchandise credit.

rules.text: Returns with a receipt received outside the returns timeframe may qualify for a merchandise credit redeemable in store.
rules.quote: Returns with a receipt received outside the returns timeframe may qualify for a merchandise credit. This credit is redeemable in store at any HomeGoods store location.

rules.text: Merchandise that is used or in unsellable condition will not be accepted for refund, store credit or exchange.
rules.quote: Merchandise that is used or in unsellable condition will not be accepted for refund, store credit or exchange.

rules.text: Any item not returned in original condition will be returned at the customer’s expense.
rules.quote: Any item not meeting the condition standards of this policy will be returned at the customer’s expense.

rules.text: Holiday purchases made between October 5, 2025 and December 24, 2025 may be returned through January 24, 2026.
rules.quote: Purchases made between October 5, 2025 & December 24, 2025 may be returned through January 24, 2026.
